source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate simple, often asymmetric and double-serrate, smooth to mildly scabrous above, hairless or pubescent beneath
morphology_documented.flowers: Before leaves, drooping on elongated pedicels, short loose clusters (key)
morphology_documented.fruit: Elliptic samara ca. 10 mm, margin ciliate, rest of surface glabrous (key)

source_scope_note: Direct species-level details separated from genus/key information; absent historical treatments not filled by unsupported inference.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historical source notes susceptibility to Dutch elm disease, but this is a risk note not an identification trait
preservation: Additive record only; photos, credits, species records and published site unchanged
